summary.text: Allison Sweatman is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Brandon Achor.
She is a social worker who advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Allison Sweatman earned a bachelor's degree from Ouachita Baptist University in 2012 and a graduate degree from Tulane University in 2020.
Her career experience includes working as a social worker, and she worked as a legislative editor for the 2021 General Session of the Arkansas State Legislature.
Sweatman has served as a member of the National Association of Social Workers and has worked with Disability Rights Arkansas.
Sweatman was the Democratic candidate for the same Senate seat in 2022, when incumbent Jane English defeated her and Libertarian Noah Jones in the general election.
In the 2026 Democratic primary she defeated Jason Williams with 54.7 percent of the vote.
